verses.en: The Inevitable Hour!
What is the Inevitable Hour?
What will explain to you what the Inevitable Hour is?
The people of Thamud and 'Ad denied that the crashing blowwould come:
Thamud was destroyed by a deafening blast;
Ad was destroyed by a furious wind
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ

verses.en: that God let loose against them for seven consecutive nights, eight consecutive days, so that you could have seen its people lying dead like hollow palm-trunks.
verses.ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ

verses.en: Can you see any trace of them now?
And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
verses.ar: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ

verses.en: these people committed grave sins and disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an ever-tightening grip.
verses.ar: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً

verses.en: But when the Flood rose high, We saved you in the floating ship,
verses.ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ

verses.en: making that event a reminder for you: attentive ears may take heed.
verses.ar: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ

verses.en: When the Trumpet is sounded a single time,
verses.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ

verses.en: when the earth and its mountains are raised high and then crushed with a single blow,
verses.ar: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً

verses.en: on that Day the Great Event will come to pass.
The sky will be torn apart on that Day, it will be so frail.
The angels will be on all sides of it and, on that Day, eight of them will bear the throne of your Lord above them.
verses.ar: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ

verses.en: On that Day you will be brought to judgement and none of your secrets will remain hidden.
verses.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ

verses.en: Anyone who is given his Record in his right hand will say, ‘Here is my Record, read it.
verses.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ

verses.en: I knew I would meet my Reckoning,’
and so he will have a pleasant life
in a lofty Garden,
with clustered fruit within his reach.
It will be said, ‘Eat and drink to your heart’s content as a reward for what you have done in days gone by.’
verses.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ

verses.en: But anyone who is given his Record in his left hand will say, ‘If only I had never been given any Record
verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ

verses.en: and knew nothing of my Reckoning.
How I wish death had been the end of me.
My wealth has been no use to me,
and my power has vanished.’
‘Take him, put a collar on him,
lead him to burn in the blazing Fire,
and [bind him] in a chain seventy metres long:
verses.ar: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ

verses.en: he would not believe in Almighty God,
verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

verses.en: he never encouraged feeding the hungry,
so today he has no real friend here,
and the only food he has is the filth
that only sinners eat.’
So I swear by what you can see
and by what you cannot see:
this [Quran] is the speech of an honoured messenger,
not the words of a poet- how little you believe!-
verses.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ

verses.en: nor the words of a soothsayer- how little you reflect!
verses.ar: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ

verses.en: This [Quran] is a message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds:
if [the Prophet] had attributed some fabrication to Us,
We would certainly have seized his right hand
and cut off his lifeblood,
and none of you could have defended him.
verses.ar: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ

verses.en: This [Quran] is a reminder for those who are aware of God.
We know that some of you consider it to be lies-
this will be a source of bitter regret for the disbelievers-
but it is in fact the certain Truth.
So [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Almighty.
